say:1:1035814101:1.text: The temple is fortunate to have your wholehearted support, Magister Merlin.
say:1:1035814101:1.source_cn: 能得到“梅林”如此真挚的承诺，这是圣堂和我的荣幸。
say:1:1035814101:1.male: The temple is fortunate to have your wholehearted support, Magister Merlin.
say:1:1035814101:1.female: The temple is fortunate to have your wholehearted support, Magister Merlin.

say:2:1035814102:1.text: May Dura bless you and keep you from harm, now and forever.
say:2:1035814102:1.source_cn: 愿女神庇佑您，永远不会遭受邪恶的侵害。
say:2:1035814102:1.male: May Dura bless you and keep you from harm, now and forever.
say:2:1035814102:1.female: May Dura bless you and keep you from harm, now and forever.
